statement: A foreign professional, manager, executive or technician needs an Employment Pass to work in Singapore; candidates must earn at least $5,600 a month, the employer must advertise the role on MyCareersFuture and consider all candidates fairly before applying, and eligibility runs in two stages — the qualifying salary, then the COMPASS points framework.
caveat: The qualifying salary is higher in financial services and rises with age, and foreign founders of venture-backed or innovative businesses can use the EntrePass route instead. Applications and renewals run through MOM's EP eService; check the live thresholds before relying.
reviewer: Starter editorial review; independent domain expert review pending
